definitions.explanation: The art of writing; literature as a creative and artistic pursuit. Encompasses novels, poetry, drama, essays, and other written forms of artistic expression.

examples.japanese: {文芸|ぶんげい}⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{文芸|ぶんげい}⟦{批評|ひひょう}→批評：03581_hihyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んでいる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
examples.english: I am studying literary criticism at university.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{文芸|ぶんげい}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦していて→する：00392_suru⟧、{毎号|まいごう}⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{短編|たんぺん}→短編：04512_tanpen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{掲載|けいさい}される→掲載する：19217_keisaisuru⟧。
examples.english: That magazine has a rich literary section, with a short story by a new author published in every issue.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in compound nouns and as a general term for literary culture. Common in academic and publishing contexts. Not used for non-literary writing (technical, journalistic, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {文芸|ぶんげい}⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: literary work
- {文芸|ぶんげい}⟦{批評|ひひょう}→批評：03581_hihyou⟧: literary criticism
- {文芸|ぶんげい}⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧: literary magazine
- {文芸|ぶんげい}⟦{欄|らん}→欄：03901_ran⟧: literary section/column
- {文芸|ぶんげい}⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧: literary club (school)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧: literature (academic field, broader scope)
- {文芸|ぶんげい} emphasizes the artistic/creative dimension, while ⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧ is the broader academic term
